HERO_DESCRIPTION: This site is billed through Vercel and needs its own FastComments login.
BLOCKED_HEADING: This login already owns another account.
BLOCKED_BODY: Each FastComments login owns one account, and yours is already tied to a different one. We did not move it, because that would take your existing site away from you.
NOT_ADMIN_HEADING: You need admin access on this Vercel team.
NOT_ADMIN_BODY: Opening this site signs you in as its account owner, which includes billing, API keys and moderation. Vercel's Viewer and Billing roles are read-only, so ask an owner of the Vercel team to open it instead.
UNVERIFIED_EMAIL_HEADING: Vercel has not verified your email address.
UNVERIFIED_EMAIL_BODY: We match your FastComments account by email address, so we only accept one Vercel has confirmed belongs to you. Verify your email with Vercel, then open this site again.
BLOCKED_NEXT_STEPS: Open the site from Vercel using a team member whose email is not already a FastComments account owner, or contact support and we will link this site to your existing login.
